name: Creo Co.,Ltd.
summary: Creo Co.,Ltd. develops information systems and provides related services in Japan. The company offers ZeeM, a human resource, payroll, and accounting solution; systems development, maintenance, and management services; contract development support services; and help desk, technical support, and other support and services, as well as call center services. The company was formerly known as Tokai Create CO., LTD. and changed its name to Creo Co.,Ltd. in 1989. Creo Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1974 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
